description: South Dakota motorcycle delta: helmet law and lane rules. National riding skills stay in core_motorcycle.json.

questions.q: Who must wear a helmet on a motorcycle in South Dakota?
questions.explanation: State law lists South Dakota as requiring a helmet for riders 17 and younger.

questions.q: A South Dakota rider who is age 18 or older
options: Must wear one on every trip
questions.explanation: The South Dakota age rule is aimed at riders 17 and younger. Some states add a novice or insurance condition, so read the statute before riding without a helmet.

questions.q: What does South Dakota law say about riding a motorcycle between lanes of traffic?
options: Only lane filtering is allowed, when traffic is stopped or slow
Riding between lanes of traffic is not allowed
questions.explanation: South Dakota: riding between lanes of traffic is not allowed.
questions.remember: South Dakota between lanes: not allowed.

questions.q: What does South Dakota require for a motorcycle rider's eye protection?
options: Required unless the motorcycle has a windshield
questions.explanation: South Dakota: eye protection is required unless the motorcycle has a windshield.
questions.remember: South Dakota eyewear: required unless there is a windshield.

questions.q: In South Dakota, what is the youngest age for a motorcycle learner's permit?
questions.explanation: South Dakota issues a motorcycle permit at 14 years at the earliest.
questions.remember: South Dakota motorcycle permit: 14 years at the earliest.
